openProviderDeferred.title: Winkel messen, zeichnen und fachsprachlich beschreiben
openProviderDeferred.notes: Withdrawn after user review: repeated Nano Banana Pro attempts represented angle measurement with the Geodreieck incorrectly or ambiguously. Fachliche requirement: the Geodreieck keeps its fixed 45-45-90 shape; for measuring, its zero point/midpoint lies on the angle vertex and the long base lies on one side of the angle. The active `resourceLinks` image reference and published asset copies were removed. Revisit when the provider handles precise tool-use diagrams more reliably.

rejectedNotLinked.title: Potenzen von Wurzeltermen vereinfachen
rejectedNotLinked.notes: One image was generated, but it mixed the target with partial radicizing and denominator rationalization. That was not focused enough for the atomic goal, so the `goal-visualization` resource link and generated asset copies were removed. The goal remains open for a later Nano Banana run.

rejectedNotLinked.title: Kongruente sowie maßstäblich vergrößerte und verkleinerte Figuren zeichnen und begründen
rejectedNotLinked.notes: The first candidate showed a congruent copy and an enlarged triangle, but omitted a visible reduced copy although the goal explicitly includes enlarged and reduced figures. It was not imported.

rejectedNotLinked.title: Sinus- und Kosinuswerte für Winkel größer als 2π und für negative Winkel auf den Grundbereich zurückführen
rejectedNotLinked.notes: The first correction candidate covered the full circle but used several green arrowheads, making the direction ambiguous. It was not imported.

userReviewCorrections.title: Parameter trigonometrischer Funktionen deuten
userReviewCorrections.notes: The previous image was replaced because the `Periode` panel did not clearly mark only the length `π`, and the `Grundkurve` panel mixed period and amplitude cues. The replacement marks period horizontally and amplitude vertically; for `y=sin(2x)` the period arrow is restricted to `0` through `π`.

userReviewCorrections.title: Trigonometrische Graphen aus Funktionstermen zeichnen
userReviewCorrections.notes: The previous image showed the downward amplitude arrow too short. The corrected image uses `f(x)=2*sin(x)+1`, marks the midline `y=1`, max `3`, min `-1`, and shows the lower amplitude arrow from `y=1` down to `y=-1`. This addresses the reported issue.

userReviewCorrections.title: Sinus- und Kosinuswerte für Winkel größer als 2π und für negative Winkel auf den Grundbereich zurückführen
userReviewCorrections.notes: The regenerated image shows the green Grundbereich as one full 360-degree circle with a single arrowhead at the `2π` end, indicating counterclockwise direction. In the negative-angle example, `-π/3` is shown clockwise into quadrant IV and `5π/3` counterclockwise to the same terminal ray. The side examples reduce `13π/6` to `π/6` and `-π/3` to `5π/3`. This addresses the reported issue.

userReviewCorrections.title: Wurzelfunktionen graphisch untersuchen
userReviewCorrections.notes: The previous image placed the "Startpunkt (0|0)" arrow away from the origin. The corrected image marks `(0|0)` as an included point at the origin and places the "Startpunkt (0|0)" arrow directly on that point, while keeping `y=sqrt(x)`, `D=[0;∞)`, `W=[0;∞)`, and the points `(1|1)`, `(4|2)`, `(9|3)`. This addresses the reported issue.
